text:
Sasha: Quick thread to lock down a remediation accountability cadence after last week's outage. We lost track of several follow-ups. Proposing a compact flow below.
Mina: Yes please. we need something enforceable but lightweight.
Jorge: Outline it and we can iterate.
Sasha: Draft cadence: T0 = incident declared. T+24h = Remediation Owner assigned and short RCA summary (1-2 bullets). T+72h = remediation plan with owners, ETAs, and roll-forward mitigation. T+10d = progress checkpoint + evidence. T+30d = closure + pattern review.
Priya: Suggest owners: IC (short-term coordinator), Remediation Owner (executes), Review Owner (approves closure). Keep them explicit in the card metadata.
Sasha: Acceptance criteria to close an action: 1) Owner confirms fix deployed; 2) attach smoke-test or repro steps; 3) postmortem doc updated; 4) Review Owner signs off in-thread.
Mina: Add "stale" rules: if no owner update in 7d -> auto-escalate to Review Owner; if still stale 3d after that -> escalate to on-call manager.
DevOps-Bot: OpsTracker scheduled reminders: T+24h, T+72h, T+10d, T+30d for thread 1923456789. Stale escalation configured: 7d -> review-owner, +3d -> on-call-manager.
Jorge: Recommend a tiny weekly 15m "stitch" meeting for actions older than 7 days so owners can unblock each other. Optional but useful.
Priya: For recurring incidents: at T+30d run a pattern check. If match count >= 2 in 90 days, open a Pattern Ticket and tag Research/Infra. Include a short error signature in the postmortem.
Sasha: OpsTracker: can we add a consolidated Remediations board filtered by incident tag and owner so managers see outstanding + stale lanes at a glance?
OpsTracker: Created board "Remediations - Active". Default filter: tag:incident AND status:open. Stale items in separate lane. Owners can subscribe to weekly digests.
Mina: Small ask: require owners to set an ETA when accepting an action. If no ETA within 48h, mark NEEDS_ATTENTION and ping the owner.
DevOps-Bot: New rule: action assigned -> owner must set ETA within 48h or card flagged NEEDS_ATTENTION and ping sent.
Jorge: IC rotation idea: monthly rotation among on-call leads. If IC unavailable, fallback to on-call manager. Post a 2-line handoff: outgoing/incoming + top risk action + next check-in time.
Priya: External comms: status cadence while critical (every 6h), then daily until T+72h, then weekly. Customer-facing summary within 72h if customer-impacting. Comms/legal cc for regulated customers.
Sasha: I'll draft a 1-page runbook with the cadence, roles matrix, automation rules, acceptance checklist, and pilot plan. Planning a 45-day pilot on incidents created after the start date. Volunteers?
Mina: I'll join the pilot.
Jorge: Count me in for review-owner duties.
Priya: I'll help with the external comms template and legal checklist.
Sasha: Great. I'll post the draft tomorrow and enable the OpsTracker rules for pilot incidents. Thanks all.
